```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

# Lab plotting themes live in one shared file: theme_matt(), theme_matt_facets()
source(here("Scripts", "themes.R"))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = knitr::is_html_output(),
  fig.align = "center",
  # Figures are saved as Output/Figures/<chunk-label>-1.png (and .pdf),
  # which is where the manuscript looks for them. This path is kept relative
  # (to this file's folder) so image links in the GitHub .md version work.
  fig.path = "../Figures/",
  dev = c("png", "pdf"),
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  collapse = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

surv_data |> 
  mutate(prop_mortality = num_dead /total) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MP_treatment, y = prop_mortality, fill = diet)) + 
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
               outliers = F) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.85)) + 
  labs(x = "Treatment", 
       y = "Mortality (proportion)") + 
  theme_matt_facets() + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

```{r}

ctmax_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MP_treatment, y = ctmax_c, fill = diet)) + 
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  labs(x = "Treatment", 
       y = "CTmax (°C)") + 
  theme_matt() + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```


```{r}

ctmax.model = lmer(data = ctmax_data, 
                   ctmax_c ~ MP_treatment * diet + (1|file_source))

car::Anova(ctmax.model, type = "III")

```
